items.headline: Tesla's new Roadster will be a tiny part of its business, but its launch sent the stock surging. Here's why.
items.summary: Tesla stock surged 5% as Elon Musk unveiled a Roadster with SpaceX thrusters, showing off Tesla's engineering chops.
